batch.completion: All six bound saved PNGs were opened once and reviewed before this ledger was written.

images.purpose: Whole desktop course: overall flow, equations, figure placement, section spacing and final prose visibility.
images.observations: Title, prose, displayed equation shapes, one graph and its caption, repaired limitation paragraphs, coefficient material and final two-law prompt are visible. The centered text column is separated from its margins; no obvious page clipping or content overlap. Final prose and bottom whitespace are present.
images.limitations: Tall preview is an overall layout/visibility observation, not certification of every small fraction or subscript glyph at native resolution.

images.purpose: Saved desktop viewport: title, introductory text, historical footnote, first state-equation display and naming/kelvin paragraphs.
images.observations: Actual pixels show the page start, not polarization content or a dedicated glossary close-up. Heading and body are clear; the first fractional equation is rendered, not raw LaTeX. Content fits the column without overlap. The lower viewport boundary is ordinary continuation of the document.
images.limitations: Filename is a reused capture label. No claim that this image proves the later glossary or every later equation.

images.purpose: Saved desktop figure-only capture: actual rendered graph labels, line styles and clipping/overlap.
images.observations: p, T, zero, V1, V2 and the V1<V2 inequality are readable, including distinct subscript digits. The two complete rays, dashed lower-temperature parts and solid outer parts are distinguishable. Axis arrows and labels remain inside the image without collisions.
images.limitations: This verifies saved display visibility of the already approved graph, not source fidelity, original SVG geometry or scientific correctness anew.

images.purpose: Whole mobile course: wrapping, graph placement, equations, repaired limitations and final prose/document end.
images.observations: The narrow text column wraps within side margins. The graph is nonblank, complete and separated from prose; its caption and surrounding paragraphs are visible. Fractional equation shapes, coefficient equation and gamma/alpha line appear rendered and fit horizontally. Repaired paragraphs remain before the next separator. The final prompt continues to its last equation reference and bottom whitespace without a cut-off page end.
images.limitations: Long preview can be scaled by the viewer. Fine equation glyphs are not individually certified. The final equation reference wraps over two lines; its continuation is visible, not missing.

images.purpose: Saved mobile viewport: page-start readability, title/breadcrumb wrapping and introductory paragraph/footnote layout.
images.observations: Title, body and footnote text are clear at the saved viewport scale. The repeated breadcrumb wraps within the width. No visible overlap or horizontal clipping. The footnote continues below the viewport edge, as the whole-course image confirms; this is a viewport boundary, not document truncation.
images.limitations: The image does not show the later figure, equations or repaired glossary at viewport scale; no such coverage is claimed.

images.purpose: Saved mobile figure-only capture: normal-width label readability, complete line styles and edge clearance.
images.observations: All six intended labels are readable and distinct, including subscript 1/2. The inequality is separated from the upper ray; p, T and zero remain visible inside the capture. Dashed portions remain distinct from solid lines. No missing ray, clipped arrow/label, overlap or blank region substituting for the graph is observed.
images.limitations: Recorded DOM minimum label size is about 19.019px. This supports the actual saved display, not a new original-figure review or cross-platform font certification.
